name: NCAA D-III Niagara Regional Cross Country Championships
headline: NCAA D-III Niagara Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Final: No. 4 SUNY Geneseo won the men’s race with 27 points over No. 8 NYU (52) as Emerson Comer (24:33.8) and James Tette went 1-2. No. 13 SUNY Geneseo also beat No. 1 NYU for the women’s title, 39 to 58, with its five scorers between fifth and 12th. RIT’s Kathryn Arbegast won the women’s race in 21:02.8, 15 seconds ahead of NYU’s Ashlyn Pallotta.
